text:
O Jesus, through the most pure heart of Mary,
I offer you all the prayers, works, sufferings, and joys
of this day,
for all the intentions of your most Sacred Heart,
in union with the holy sacrifice of the Mass
throughout the world,
and in reparation for my sins.
Amen.
latin:
O Iesu, per purissimum cor Mariae,
tibi offero omnes orationes, opera, passiones et gaudia
huius diei,
pro omnibus intentionibus Cordis tui Sacratissimi,
in unione cum sancto Missae sacrificio
per totum mundum,
et in reparationem peccatorum meorum.
Amen.
